dataset_metadata.product_name: NASA POWER Native Resolution Daily Meteorology / GMAO MERRA-2 & GPM IMERG Calibrated Precipitation
dataset_metadata.source_agency: NASA Earth Science Division / Applied Sciences Program (LaRC & GSFC)
dataset_metadata.parameter_description: Precipitation Corrected (mm/day) derived from GMAO MERRA-2 assimilation and calibrated against NASA GPM IMERG / GPCP satellite products
dataset_metadata.spatial_resolution: 0.5 degree latitude x 0.625 degree longitude global grid

methodology.grid_cell_extraction: Event latitude and longitude snapped to NASA native grid cell center
methodology.accumulation_window_convention: Trailing cumulative antecedent window inclusive of the event date T_0

window_definitions.rainfall_1d: Precipitation on event date T_0 [T_0, T_0] (1 day)
window_definitions.rainfall_3d: Accumulated precipitation across [T_0 - 2 days, T_0] (3 days)
window_definitions.rainfall_7d: Accumulated precipitation across [T_0 - 6 days, T_0] (7 days)
window_definitions.rainfall_15d: Accumulated precipitation across [T_0 - 14 days, T_0] (15 days)
window_definitions.rainfall_30d: Accumulated precipitation across [T_0 - 29 days, T_0] (30 days)

methodology.authenticity_verification: Strictly genuine NASA satellite/reanalysis observations; 0 synthetic or fabricated values
methodology.caching_strategy: Local persistent SQLite cache at ml/data/cache/rainfall_cache.sqlite
